entries.hypothesis: People burned by hard paywalls will respond to a free tier stated as an absolute with no trial trap.
entries.hook: Free means the workouts. All of them. Forever.
entries.format: static card, hook plus Ready Screen UI
entries.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

entries.hypothesis: People who quit apps after an unfair reset will respond to a forgiving rolling score with nothing to lose.
entries.hook: Missing a day never zeroes you out.
entries.format: 12s screen-record video, missed day then unchanged score
entries.preregistered_success_signal: 3-second hold rate above account median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: hold rate below account median on two consecutive 7-day reads

entries.hypothesis: People with decision fatigue will respond to a demo where the session already exists at app open.
entries.hook: Open the app. Your workout is already there.
entries.format: 8s screen-record video, cold open to ready session
entries.preregistered_success_signal: watch-through to the Start tap above account median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: watch-through below account median on two consecutive 7-day reads

entries.hypothesis: People squeezed by fixed 60-minute plans will respond to a 5-minute floor that still counts.
entries.hook: Five minutes on a hotel-room floor still counts.
entries.format: static card, hook plus 5-60 minute range shown in UI
entries.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

entries.hypothesis: Offline-first demanders will respond to on-device generation shown with airplane mode on.
entries.hook: A session is ready in under 100 milliseconds, offline.
entries.format: 10s screen-record video, airplane mode toggle then app open
entries.preregistered_success_signal: comment sentiment naming offline as the reason, plus above-median hold rate over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: no offline-naming comments and below-median hold rate after 14 days

entries.hypothesis: People misled by equipment creep will respond to zero-equipment as a hard boundary, not a bullet.
entries.hook: A floor, a wall, and five minutes.
entries.format: static card, person in socks on a rug, hook overlaid
entries.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads

entries.hypothesis: People who lost progress to sync failures will respond to everything living on the phone by architecture.
entries.hook: Built on your phone. Nothing to lose to a sync.
entries.format: static card, hook plus offline UI state
entries.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions beats the angle-bank median over 7 days
entries.kill_criterion: bottom-quartile saves per 1,000 impressions across two consecutive 7-day reads
